post.summary: Send an e-mail from a template
post.description: The answer is the message as the delivery log keeps it. It is saved before its first attempt and sent at once unless a delayed send or quiet hours hold it; an attempt that fails or breaks off answers retrying and is tried again on later uses of your website, then on the fallback channel. Someone who unsubscribed gets only required messages (else skipped, reason unsubscribed); send limits skip with reason limited. 422 template_not_found when the key has no e-mail template; 422 validation_failed for a field; 403 feature_off for your own keys without Merchant send API (send_api), or sendAt without Delayed send. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retried request sends once.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your own per request: the same request again within 24 hours gets the first answer (Idempotent-Replayed: true); another request with it answers 409 duplicate_request.

secretValues.description: Names of values the delivery log hides, for example ["code", "link"].

required.description: true sends it also to someone who unsubscribed (for example an order update from an optional template).

language.description: A language code such as en, fr or pt-BR (default: to.language).

sendAt.description: Delayed send: at most the setting's days ahead (30 by default); a past time sends now. accounts. templates always go at once.

post.summary: Send a browser push to a visitor from a template
post.description: The template's subject is the title and its text the body; a url value (https://… or a path) opens on a click. The answer is the message as the delivery log keeps it: failed when no browser is subscribed for the subscriber id. An attempt that fails or breaks off answers retrying and is tried again on later uses of your website. 422 template_not_found when the key has no push template; 422 validation_failed for a field; 403 feature_off for your own keys without Merchant send API (send_api), or sendAt without Delayed send. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retried request sends once.

post.summary: Ticket for an admin widget (15 minutes)
post.description: Your server asks for a ticket for the member of your staff who opens an admin widget. Permissions of switched-off features are left out of the ticket.

origin.description: The https origin of the page that shows the widget (a local origin while testing).

ticket.description: Give it to the admin widget (data-ticket).

browserToken.description: The website's browser token: visitor routes, from https://<exact domain> or a local origin.

serverToken.description: The website's server token: the merchant's server only, never with an Origin header. It also reaches every visitor route, acting for the visitor named by SS-Visitor-IP (and SS-Sign-In).

ticket.description: A ticket from POST /v1/tickets: admin widgets, only from the origin it names.

SSVisitorIp.name: SS-Visitor-IP
SSVisitorIp.description: With the server token: the visitor's IP address (required on writes, else 400 visitor_ip_required). These calls count in their own window of 3,000 requests per minute per route per website, plus the per-visitor limits.

SSActorId.name: SS-Actor-Id
SSActorId.description: With the server token: the member of your staff the call acts for (1–64 of A–Z a–z 0–9 _ . : @ -).

SSActorName.name: SS-Actor-Name
SSActorName.description: The acting member's name, percent-encoded UTF-8, at most 120 characters (with SS-Actor-Id).

SSActorRole.name: SS-Actor-Role
SSActorRole.description: The acting member's role, percent-encoded UTF-8, at most 40 characters.

action.description: What was done, for example payment.refunded.

target.description: The id of what it was done to.

label.description: A name for the target, for example an order number.

Actor.description: Who did it: user (the acting user of a server call), staff (a ticket's user) or server.

provider.description: smtp, resend, sendgrid, mailgun, ses, twilio, meta, http (a gateway over HTTP) or webpush; none when no provider was called (the feature is off, the channel is not connected, a database or provider was briefly unreachable).

error.description: Why it failed, in English (failed attempts only).

Button.description: A button of a WhatsApp template at Meta that takes a value.

index.description: The button's place in the template at Meta (the first is 0), once each.

type.description: url: the value is added to the end of the button's address; copy_code: the button copies the value.

value.description: May hold placeholders and optional sections, for example {code}.

Channel.description: push is browser push to a visitor, staff_push browser push to a member of your staff.

Connection.description: A connection as screens see it: secrets never come back.

last4.description: The last 4 characters of the secret ('' when none).

Count.description: How many records match the list's filters.

capped.description: True when there are more than 100,000 (count is then 100,000).

Counts.description: The matching records counted by one field.

groups.description: Value → count, the 50 largest groups; a missing value is counted as none.

EmailRecipient.description: The recipient: email is required; phone is used by the fallback channel (SMS or WhatsApp). Each member given must be valid (422 validation_failed at to/<member>).

email.description: An e-mail address (kept in lower case).

phone.description: With its calling code: + or 00 first, for example +447700900123; spaces, dashes, dots, slashes and brackets are dropped, and a trunk 0 after the code too.

language.description: The recipient's language, for example en, fr or pt-BR: it picks the template version while Multi-language templates are on.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Paris: quiet hours end in it (else the business.json time zone).

locale.description: A language tag (en, en-GB, fr-FR), or '' for the viewer's.

Message.description: A message as the delivery log keeps it. It never holds a secret: the values of a sensitive template (every accounts. template) and those the send named in secretValues show as ****** (or [link hidden] for a link) in subject and text; the recipient got the real words.

template.description: The template key; null for a one-off message from your staff.

source.description: api: your server or a product; staff: your staff in the admin widgets.

channel.description: The channel now: after a fallback, the fallback channel.

to.description: The address on channel: an e-mail address (lower case), a phone number (+ and digits), a browser push subscriber id or a staff user id.

reason.description: skipped: unsubscribed or limited (over a send limit); retrying and failed: the last error, in English; else null.

subject.description: The e-mail subject or push title ('' for SMS and WhatsApp), hidden values replaced.

attempts.description: Every attempt, on every channel, oldest first.

dueAt.description: When it is (or was) due: later for a delayed send, quiet hours or a retry.

MessagePage.description: One page of the delivery log, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

MessageStatus.description: queued: waiting for its time (a delayed send or quiet hours) or being sent; retrying: an attempt failed and it is tried again on a later use of your website; sent; failed: every attempt failed, the fallback channel's too; skipped: not sent (reason unsubscribed or limited).

PhoneRecipient.description: The recipient: phone is required; email is used by the fallback channel (e-mail). Each member given must be valid (422 validation_failed at to/<member>).

phone.description: With its calling code: + or 00 first, for example +447700900123; spaces, dashes, dots, slashes and brackets are dropped, and a trunk 0 after the code too.

email.description: An e-mail address (kept in lower case).

language.description: The recipient's language, for example en, fr or pt-BR: it picks the template version while Multi-language templates are on.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Paris: quiet hours end in it (else the business.json time zone).

Problem.description: An error (RFC 9457, application/problem+json). The last segment of type is a stable code, for example validation_failed.

requestId.description: Quote it when you contact support.

errors.description: validation_failed: what is wrong, field by field.

path.description: JSON Pointer of the field, for example /amount.

PushSubscriptionInput.description: The browser's subscription as PushSubscription.toJSON() gives it.

p256dh.description: The browser's P-256 public key (65 bytes, base64url).

StaffRecipient.description: The recipient: a member of your staff, on every browser where they turned staff notifications on (at most 20). Each member given must be valid (422 validation_failed at to/<member>).

staffId.description: The user id in their ticket.

language.description: The recipient's language, for example en, fr or pt-BR: it picks the template version while Multi-language templates are on.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Paris: quiet hours end in it (else the business.json time zone).

subscriberId.description: The same endpoint keeps its id.

SubscriberRecipient.description: The recipient: a visitor's browser. Each member given must be valid (422 validation_failed at to/<member>).

subscriberId.description: The subscriber id the push-permission widget announces (the ss-notifications:subscribed event).

language.description: The recipient's language, for example en, fr or pt-BR: it picks the template version while Multi-language templates are on.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Paris: quiet hours end in it (else the business.json time zone).

Template.description: A template: one per key, channel and language.

key.description: Keys of other products' own events start with the product id (accounts., ecommerce., chat., payments., growth.); every other key is yours.

language.description: default for the version every recipient falls back to, else a language code such as en, fr or pt-BR.

subject.description: The e-mail subject or push title ('' for SMS and WhatsApp).

text.description: The words: {name} where a value goes, {?name}…{/name} around text shown only when name is not empty.

required.description: Sent also to people who unsubscribed (always true for accounts. templates).

urgent.description: Sent during quiet hours (always true for accounts. templates).

providerTemplate.description: WhatsApp: the name of an approved template at Meta ('' sends plain text).

buttons.description: By index; only a WhatsApp template with a providerTemplate has them.

sensitive.description: Its values are hidden in the delivery log (always true for accounts. templates).

TemplateInput.description: A template to save: one with the same key, channel and language is replaced.

key.description: 1–64 lower-case letters, digits, _, . or -, starting with a letter.

language.description: default ('', null or none) for the default version, else a language code such as en, fr or pt-BR.

subject.description: Required for email, push and staff_push: one line of at most 200 characters (trimmed); ignored for SMS and WhatsApp.

text.description: Trimmed, not empty; at most 100,000 characters for e-mail, 1600 for SMS, 4096 for WhatsApp and 500 for push. Every {?name} is closed by a later {/name}.

providerTemplate.description: WhatsApp only: the template name at Meta (lower case, digits and _, at most 512).

buttons.description: Only for a WhatsApp template with a providerTemplate.

TemplateList.description: The templates, by key, channel and language.

colors.description: Colour name → #rrggbb (the product's CSS supplies the others).

Values.description: The template's {placeholders}: up to 50 names (a letter, then letters, digits and _; not unsubscribeUrl, which Notifications fills) with texts of at most 1000 characters or numbers.

ValueSource.description: Where a value comes from: saved for this website, the global default, or built in.
